items.text: A security firm, Dream, says hackers chained the PHP flaws with a Linux bug to break into 25 real servers on Oct 23-24, including two firewalls at a US government-linked body. No victim is named and none has confirmed it.
Coding app Warp says a breach at one of its vendors exposed AI agent logs and telemetry for roughly 1% of its users; CrowdStrike is investigating.
North Carolina's governor wants regulators to make data centers pay for the power and grid costs they add, instead of households.
